source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ultrasound and the piezoelectric effect (PDF 157-158).

blocks.text: Ultrasound wasee istemal wala, jism mein dakhal na dene wala (non-invasive) imaging tareeqa hai jo tissues, aza aur hamal mein bachche jaisi andaruni banawatein dikhata hai. Yeh piezoelectric effect naam ke usool par kaam karta hai, jo ultrasound transducer ki bunyaad hai. Transducer ka dohra kaam hai: yeh ultrasound lehrein banata aur jism ke andar se mun'akis signals pakarta hai.

Lafz 'piezoelectric' Greek 'piezein', yani dabana, se nikla hai; 'electric' bijli ka hawala hai. Yeh asar 1880 mein French scientists Pierre Curie aur Jacques Curie ne daryaft kiya, jinhon ne dekha ke quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt (sodium potassium tartrate) jaise crystals par mechanical dabao dalne se bijli ka charge paida hota hai. Aise crystals ka koi markaz-e-tanasub (centre of symmetry) nahi; un ke andar musbat aur manfi charge ke chhote hisse hote hain jo aam taur par mutawazin hote hain. Dabao dalne par tawazun bigarta aur charges thora khisakte hain, is liye satahon ke aar-paar electric field ban jata hai: yeh direct piezoelectric effect hai. Agar is ke bajaye crystal par electric field lagaya jaye to us ki shakal thori badal jati hai: yeh converse piezoelectric effect hai (Fig 20.1).

blocks.alt: Baen (direct effect): do dhaat ki plates ke darmiyan gulabi PZT crystal oopar aur neeche se neele teeron se dabaya jata; oopar ki plate par plus aur neeche minus nishan, aur plates se jura voltmeter V voltage parhta. Daen (converse effect): plates se alternating voltage source jura; crystal ki shakal badalti (dashed), aur ultrasound lehrein likhi muri wavefronts oopar aur neeche phailti.
blocks.caption: Direct aur converse piezoelectric effects (Fig 20.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Wahi crystal dabao ko voltage aur voltage ko thartharahat mein badal sakta hai. Ultrasound probe dono use karta hai: pulses bhejne ke liye thartharata aur wapas aane wali goonj se voltage banata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Piezoelectric effect dabao ko voltage aur voltage ko dabao mein badalna mumkin banata hai. Isi tarah ultrasound jism se 'baat' karta hai. Tibbi probes mein aam taur par PZT, lead zirconate titanate, use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Direct aur converse piezoelectric effect mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Direct: crystal par mechanical dabao voltage paida karta hai. Converse: lagaya gaya voltage crystal ki shakal badalta hai (is liye alternating voltage use thartharata hai).

items: Piezoelectric effect (Curies, 1880): markaz-e-tanasub ke baghair crystals mein dabao se voltage.
Converse effect: voltage crystal ki shakal badalta; ultrasound banane mein use.
